books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
books.description: Wealth, illusion, and the American Dream.
books.content:
In my younger and more vulnerable years my father gave me some advice...

The story unfolds with quiet elegance. Gatsby stands at the edge of the dock, staring toward the green light across the bay. His hope feels infinite, stretched thin between memory and illusion.

[Extended repeated paragraphs for pagination testing]

Gatsby believed in the green light, the orgastic future that year by year recedes before us...

books.title: Crime and Punishment
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.content:
On an exceptionally hot evening early in July a young man came out of the garret...

Raskolnikov walked slowly, as though each step demanded a moral justification. The oppressive heat mirrored the weight inside his mind...

He oscillated between arrogance and despair.

annotations.comment: The green light as a metaphor for unreachable desire.
The murder is framed as philosophical experiment.

notes.content: Compare Gatsby’s illusion with modern influencer culture.
